basic_info.description: This exceptional 3 bedroom 3.5 bath, full-floor apartment offers a grand scale in an unparalleled location. Recently renovated, the home offers systems for security, climate control, and lighting. From the elegant lobby, the elevator opens to your private entry. The stunning living and dining areas are flooded with natural light from the south-facing windows, with exterior wrought iron railings. The room is balanced by an inviting fireplace and the dining area at each end. Tall ceilings and ample wall space are ideal for displaying your collection of art. The dining area opens to the professionally-equipped kitchen. With high-end appliances, center-island, wine-coolers, and ample work space, this is sure to please the most discerning chef. Next to the kitchen, the family room is ideal for casual relaxation, while the sheltered patio offers an inviting outdoor space. A half bath is located off the hall leading to the bedroom wing. The office and laundry are also found here. The first two bedrooms have ample closets and en-suite baths. The primary suite boasts dual walk-in closets, and the bath offers double sinks, soaking tub and stall shower. One-car parking with EV charger, storage, and onsite manager add convenience. Minutes to Fillmore St, Lafayette and Alta Plaza parks.
